one_sentence_story: Staring hard at a desk locks your brain in a tight rut. Take an easy walk or warm bath, and new ideas jump by 41 percent.
so_what_for_you: Work on a hard task for twenty minutes, then leave your phone at home. Take a short walk or wash dishes so the fix can click.
